In this video, we compared two of the most popular term insurance plans in India,
 "Axis Max Life Smart Term Plan Plus" and "ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus".  

✅ What you’ll learn in this video:  
- Key features & benefits of Axis Max Life Smart Term Plan Plus  
- Key features & benefits of ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus  
- Eligibility, maturity age, riders, and premium options  
- Pros & cons of both plans  
- Which plan suits your needs better in 2025  

👉 Axis Max Life Smart Term Plan Plus Highlights:  
- 7 plan variants for customization  
- Terminal illness cover included  
- Riders: Accidental Death, Disability Benefit, Waiver of Premium  
- Coverage up to age 85  

👉 ICICI Pru iProtect Smart Plus Highlights:  
- Coverage up to 99 years  
- Critical Illness Rider, Premium Break Option, Family Protect Rider  
- Women discount up to 15% on premiums  
- Online discounts & paperless KYC  

💡 Our Verdict:  
- Choose Axis Max Life if you want "customizable variants under one plan".  
- Choose ICICI Pru iProtect if you want "longer coverage + riders + discounts".
